resources.string: Pick a log file to see the position fixes in it.\n\nThe reading is the same common code the JVM, Node, macOS and browser demos run — only opening the file differs, and here that is contentResolver.openInputStream(uri).asSource().buffered().
No fixes in that file.\n\nA fix needs a position and a velocity in the same update cycle, so a log of, say, depth and wind sentences alone will show nothing here.
